# Decisions

The single decision log for this repo: dated rulings, newest last. Every entry is a level-2 heading
`## YYYY-MM-DD <title>`. Say in plain words what was decided and why, so a reader who was not in the
discussion understands it. A change to VISION.md, to the milestone order in ROADMAP.md or to a
milestone's success criteria is added in the same change as an entry that cites the chat where the owner
confirmed it ("confirmed by <who> in chat: <where>").
